run_nms: run non-maximum suppression on detection boxes and scores to filter overlapping predictions
review_nms: review the nms wrapper that wraps a C extension with AMP float_function for fp32 inputs
summarize_nms: summarize the nms function which performs non-maximum suppression using a compiled C backend
test_nms: test the nms function with bounding box tensors and confidence scores
refactor_nms: refactor the nms wrapper to swap the underlying C extension or change the AMP hint
